shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,620p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '360,590p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show --format= -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
rg -n \"ToolDefinitionSource|register\\(\" src/types src/orchestration/tools -g '*.ts'
rg -n \"specs/.*#|validated by\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-* | head -80
sed -n '1,180p' package.json"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry validates each call against the schema returned for that call$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,220p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | tail -190
sed -n '1,260p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
rg -n \"anchor name|spec anchor|#8\" specs scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m 'Test dynamic tool schemas per call' && git push origin HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
